source: Homework 5 failure report (analysis/report/hw5_summary.md) on the Homework 4 taxonomy; prevalence from HW4/HW5 human labels
why_agent_can_change_it: In all three traces (support-0054, support-0127, support-0169) the agent had already retrieved the facts that settle the request: order 3767 delivered 179 days earlier with both windows closed, order 7839 outside Juniper's 14-day store window, order 3521 already shipped with a cancellation policy that names the post-shipment path. It opened a ticket anyway, so the failure is in how the prompt frames escalation (the Escalation section tells the agent to escalate when unsure or when a refund exceeds the threshold, and says nothing about resolving a closed case itself), not in missing tools or data. Prevalence: 45 of the 250 Homework 3 conversations; all 65 escalating conversations were human-labeled, 45 present, and a conversation without an escalate_to_human call cannot have this failure.
